description: Trigger evals: queries that should and should not activate build-planner.
positive: Design me a 4-ft version of the cubby bench.
Plan a plywood storage cabinet for the garage, 30 inches wide.
Revise this bench design to use 3/4 plywood instead of MDF.
I need a cut list and shopping list for a workbench.
Turn the mudroom-bench brief into an actual design.
Spec out a bookshelf that fits a 72 by 36 inch wall.
negative: Does this cut list close on 36 inches?
I only have a vague idea for a coffee table — help me scope it.
I finished the benches; update the shop inventory.
Render the print-ready HTML build guide from this spec.
What tools do I have confirmed?
notes: Positives are design/spec/cut-list requests. Negatives belong to cut-verifier (bare check), project-intake (scoping), shop-close-out (logging), or guide-renderer (rendering).
